title: JMS Configuration
description: Unified schema for all JMS-related configuration files. Validates either a queue-managers.yaml file (defining JMS broker connections) or a per-destination JMS config file located in config/jms-config/ (defining queue/topic metadata, message format, and correlation rules). The two formats are mutually exclusive: a queue-managers file has a top-level 'queue_managers' key, while a destination config file has a top-level 'destination' key.

queueManagersFile.title: Queue Managers File
queueManagersFile.description: Top-level structure of queue-managers.yaml. Defines named JMS broker connections (IBM MQ, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ). Referenced by 'queue_manager_ref' in rules, test suites, and jms-config files.

queue_managers.description: Dictionary of queue manager configurations, keyed by a reference name used elsewhere (e.g. 'qm_us_east').

queueManager.description: Configuration for a single queue manager. The required fields vary by provider (see ibmMQConfig, activeMQConfig, rabbitMQConfig).

broker_url.description: Broker connection string in IBM MQ format: 'hostname(port)'.

username.description: Username for authentication. Password is supplied via the JMS_<QM_NAME>_PASSWORD environment variable.

ssl_key_store.description: Path to the SSL keystore file (PEM format) for TLS connections.

ssl_key_store_password.description: Password for the SSL keystore. Prefer supplying this via an environment variable.

pool.description: Per-queue-manager connection pool settings. Overrides the global JMS_POOL_* environment variables.

activeMQConfig.description: ActiveMQ specific configuration (uses STOMP protocol via stomp.py).

broker_url.description: Broker address in 'host:port' format for STOMP.

vhost.description: Virtual host name (rarely needed with ActiveMQ).

pool.description: Per-queue-manager connection pool settings. Overrides the global JMS_POOL_* environment variables.

rabbitMQConfig.description: RabbitMQ specific configuration (uses AMQP protocol via pika).

broker_url.description: Broker address in 'host:port' format for AMQP.

pool.description: Per-queue-manager connection pool settings. Overrides the global JMS_POOL_* environment variables.

poolConfig.description: Connection pool configuration for a queue manager. All fields are optional — omitted fields fall back to the global JMS_POOL_* environment variables.

min_idle.description: Minimum number of idle connections to keep alive.

max_size.description: Maximum number of connections in the pool.

max_wait_ms.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait for a connection to become available.

idle_timeout_ms.description: How long (ms) an idle connection may remain in the pool before being closed (default: 15 minutes).

max_lifetime_ms.description: Maximum total lifetime (ms) of a connection regardless of activity (default: 30 minutes).

auto_reconnect.description: Re-establish connections automatically after a failure.

reconnect_attempts.description: Number of times to retry a failed connection before giving up.

reconnect_delay_ms.description: Initial delay (ms) between reconnection attempts. Subsequent attempts use exponential back-off.

destinationConfig.title: JMS Destination Config
destinationConfig.description: Per-destination JMS configuration file (config/jms-config/*.yaml). Each file (or '---'-separated document within a file) describes one JMS queue or topic: which queue manager to use, the message format, optional JMS delivery properties, and correlation-ID extraction/propagation rules.

destination.description: JMS queue or topic name, exactly as it exists on the broker.

destination_type.description: Whether this destination is a queue or a pub/sub topic.

queue_manager_ref.description: Key of the queue manager in queue-managers.yaml to use for this destination. Use 'default' to pick the first registered queue manager.

provider.description: JMS provider type. Must match the 'provider' field of the referenced queue manager.

message.description: Message format settings for this destination.

format.description: Serialisation format for messages on this destination.

jms_properties.description: JMS / IBM MQ delivery properties applied when producing messages to this destination.

persistence.description: Persist messages so they survive a broker restart (maps to MQPER_PERSISTENT).

priority.description: Message priority — 0 (lowest) to 9 (highest). Maps to MQPRI_*.

expiry_ms.description: Message time-to-live in milliseconds. 0 means no expiry.

time_to_live.description: Alias for expiry_ms. Message time-to-live in milliseconds. 0 means no expiry.

correlation.description: Correlation-ID extraction and propagation rules for this destination. Mirrors the structure used in topic-config.

extract.description: Ordered list of rules for extracting a correlation ID from incoming messages. Rules are tried in ascending priority order; the first successful extraction wins.

name.description: JMS property / header name to read. Required when from=header.

expression.description: JSONPath expression evaluated against the message body. Required when from=jsonpath.

priority.description: Evaluation order — lower values are tried first.

propagate.description: Rules for writing the resolved correlation ID into outgoing messages sent to this destination.

to_headers.description: JMS properties / headers to set on outgoing messages. Values support the {{correlationId}} placeholder.
